name: Guiding Stars
description: The uplifting 1980s prequel to Static & Silence. It chronicles the unbreakable bond between Leo, his twin sister Luna, their older sister Stella, and his best friend Olivia, establishing the deep roots of their 'found family' dynamic before the darkness set in.
subtitle: The 2000 Prequel Album (Before the Static)
linerNotes: The uplifting 1980s-inspired prequel to Static & Silence, chronicling the unbreakable bond between Julian Croft ("Leo") and his sisters Izzy ("Luna"), Bea ("Stella"), and Charlotte before the darkness set in.
Anchored by the iconic flute and synth leitmotif that would later become Leo's cross-country lifeline, Guiding Stars establishes the warmth of the Safe Harbor that the Croft family fought to reclaim.
